name: my-experiment
description: Copy this file and edit it. Steps run in order. 'args' are the command's ordinary CLI flags without '--': strings and numbers are passed exactly, true adds a flag, false omits it, and a list repeats the flag. Reference earlier steps with ${STEP.best}, ${STEP.latest} (training checkpoints) or ${STEP.output} (evaluation report or label dataset). Output directories are created under output_root/STEP unless you set output-dir/output/log-dir. See docs/experiment_pipelines.md.

steps.description: Allowed commands: train_ppo, train_selfplay_ppo, evaluate_ppo, evaluate_selfplay_ppo, evaluate_agent_vs_agent, oracle_labels. Set learner-* to neural-train, neural-frozen or heuristic; from-scratch needs no checkpoint.
init-checkpoint starts a NEW stage from stage1 weights (fresh optimizer and counters); it is not an exact resume. Register earlier checkpoints as named opponents with a list.
Fixed held-out opponents; use a seed different from training validation.
